Terjemahkan:
>> Scott Moss: All right, so we made our agent. Like I said, now we're going to hook it up to the UI so we get a lot of cool stuff for free. We get two hooks. We're going to get a useAgent and a useAgentChat if that's not confusing enough. They're from the same people but also different packages. So useAgent comes from the Agents package, which is owned by Cloudflare. And that hook is going to manage like the WebSocket connection to the Durable Object, so it's going to create a direct connection for us. We don't have to worry about anything. It's just managed for us. It's basically free. The useAgentChat is what's going to sit on top of the useAgent and give us a familiar chat interface with a messages array, the ability to send a new message, and to get the status of a message so we can show that to the user, like we're thinking or we're doing a thing or we're calling this tool, right? So we don't have to make all that stuff from scratch.

>> Scott Moss: Oke, sekarang agent-nya sudah jadi. Seperti yang tadi saya bilang, sekarang kita tinggal menghubungkannya ke UI supaya langsung mendapatkan banyak fitur keren tanpa perlu bikin semuanya sendiri. Kita akan memakai dua hook, yaitu `useAgent` dan `useAgentChat`—kalau namanya saja belum cukup bikin bingung.

Keduanya memang dibuat oleh tim yang sama, tetapi berasal dari package yang berbeda. `useAgent` berasal dari package `agents` milik Cloudflare. Hook ini yang akan mengurus koneksi WebSocket ke Durable Object, jadi kita langsung mendapatkan koneksi yang stabil tanpa perlu mengatur semuanya sendiri. Praktis semuanya sudah diurus untuk kita.

Di atasnya ada `useAgentChat`, yang menyediakan antarmuka chat yang sudah familier. Kita mendapatkan array `messages`, fungsi untuk mengirim pesan baru, serta status setiap pesan sehingga kita bisa menampilkan ke pengguna apakah AI sedang berpikir, sedang menjalankan tool, atau sedang memproses sesuatu. Jadi kita tidak perlu membangun semua fitur itu dari nol.
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
Then we have the AI SDK message protocol. This just sits on top of the standard OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible message call. So the thing to know about OpenAI right now, like OpenAI when it comes to API SDKs, they are the standard for interacting with LLMs. So most LLM providers have an OpenAI API-compatible API. So a lot of them you can swap out by just changing the base URL, right? So I think that was a question we had earlier from the chat was like, can we swap out with a different base URL? Yes, you can, because most LLM providers support OpenAI API-compatible APIs, so you can swap them out. You can also use other services, like routing as a service where you can just connect all your providers to one API hosted somewhere, and you just use that one API, and then it'll downstream forward it to all your different providers for you.

Selanjutnya, ada protokol pesan AI SDK. Ini berjalan di atas panggilan pesan standar yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI. Hal utama yang perlu diketahui tentang OpenAI saat ini adalah mereka menjadi standar industri dalam hal API SDK untuk berinteraksi dengan LLM. Sebagian besar provider LLM sudah menyediakan API yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI API, sehingga kita bisa gonta-ganti provider hanya dengan mengubah `base_url`-nya saja.

Tadi ada pertanyaan dari chat: apakah kita bisa mengganti provider hanya dengan mengubah `base_url`? Ya, tentu saja bisa, karena mayoritas provider LLM mendukung API yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI. Kita juga bisa memakai layanan *routing-as-a-service* di mana kita cukup menghubungkan semua provider ke satu endpoint API terpusat, lalu layanan itu yang meneruskan permintaan ke berbagai provider pilihan kita.
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
They were the first ones to create an API of like this is how developers should interact with an LLM and it ended up being just like an array of messages. There's typically a role associated with it, so that role will either be something like user or assistant. The sweet thing about this is that this can be totally faked, as you'll see when we write evals, because the AI doesn't know. The AI doesn't know that this was a faked conversation. The AI doesn't know that you premade an array of messages including its own responses. It doesn't know that it didn't generate that. As far as it can tell, it did generate that. There is no state saved on a GPU somewhere that says here is everything that I've seen so far. This is why all the messages have to be sent every single time. It's stateless, so you could fabricate a message history, which is good and bad. So this is where prompt injection becomes a problem.

OpenAI adalah yang pertama membuat standar API tentang bagaimana developer berinteraksi dengan LLM, yaitu berupa array berisi objek pesan dengan role seperti `user` dan `assistant`.

Yang menarik, riwayat percakapan ini sebenarnya bisa kita buat sendiri (*mocked*). AI sama sekali tidak tahu kalau riwayat percakapan itu sebenarnya kita buat sendiri. Dari sudut pandang AI, dia menganggap dialah yang menghasilkan respons tersebut karena tidak ada state yang tersimpan di GPU yang mengingat semua percakapan sebelumnya.

Karena LLM bersifat stateless, seluruh riwayat pesan harus dikirim ulang pada setiap panggilan. Di satu sisi kita bisa membuat riwayat percakapan buatan untuk pengujian (*mock conversations*) atau evals. Di sisi lain, sifat stateless ini yang membuka celah terjadinya prompt injection.
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
More on the part stuff, nothing really crazy here, you know, parts are just like parts of a message, and they could be different types. They could be text. They could be a tool call that has a state. They could be a reasoning. Some models will show you their reasoning tokens, like you ever use a model where it's like, it'll show you what it's thinking, and then it'll be like thought for 30 seconds, and then it'll answer, and then that blurb in which it was thinking, that's the reasoning step. Not all models expose that. Some of them consider that the secret sauce. A lot of open weight, open source models do show you the reasoning steps like DeepSeek, so you can handle those, and you can show that to your user. The LLM is trying to optimize its memory as efficiently as possible. The more memory it has to hold, the more expensive that inference call is going to be, the more power it needs, the more electricity. Like it's literally, we're getting to the point of tokens to wattage.

Struktur `parts` ini membagi pesan menjadi beberapa jenis: teks biasa, pemanggilan tool (*tool call*), hingga langkah penalaran (*reasoning steps*). Beberapa model open-source seperti DeepSeek memperlihatkan *reasoning tokens* yang menampilkan proses berpikir model sebelum memberikan jawaban.

Walaupun fitur-fitur seperti *parts*, *reasoning*, dan unggahan file sangat berguna di UI, LLM sendiri selalu berusaha menghemat memori seefisien mungkin. Semakin besar memori yang diproses, semakin mahal biaya inferensi dan semakin besar daya listrik yang dibutuhkan. Kita mulai sampai di titik di mana penggunaan AI diukur dari rasio token terhadap konsumsi listrik (watt).
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
Streaming responses, we talked a little bit about it. It's handled by the AI SDK and the AI chat agent base class. It's basically instead of waiting for all the tokens to be generated in memory and then sent to us at once, we're streaming them as they're generated, OK? That's literally just like anything you've ever streamed in your entire life, a YouTube video, a response from some image upload, whatever. Tool statuses is pretty cool. It's pretty important. This allows you to customize different statuses on the tool, so you might be able to say this tool is starting, this tool is doing this thing, this tool found 10 results, this tool picked this, this tool is done, that way you can constantly show that update to the user of those different statuses as they're happening.

Untuk *streaming responses*, fitur ini ditangani oleh AI SDK dan base class AI chat agent. Jadi alih-alih menunggu semua token selesai dibuat di memori baru dikirim sekaligus, token langsung dikirim secara bertahap (*streaming*) begitu dibuat—persis seperti saat kita menonton video di YouTube.

Fitur *tool status* juga penting karena pengguna bisa melihat apa yang sedang dikerjakan AI secara langsung (misalnya: tool mulai berjalan, menemukan 10 hasil, atau selesai diproses) sehingga prosesnya terlihat transparan.
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
When would you suggest that we drop down a level and not reuse these existing SDKs and take a more low-level approach? Yeah, I think there's two reasons for that. So on the client side, when would you not use these abstractions? So a lot of these UI SDKs, they don't make a lot of assumptions or lock in on the actual UI itself. They're mostly just handling the business logic on the front end. So on the front end I would say on the back end, yeah, you will more frequently run into issues on the back end sooner that would make you want to drop down to a lower level for sure. Like ChatGPT has a feature where when you pick a model, you can pick auto, right? So how does that actually work? So what they actually do is when you send them a message, they run it through a classifier LLM first to determine the complexity of this ask, and then depending on the complexity, they route it to a specific model.

Kapan kita sebaiknya turun ke level yang lebih rendah (*low-level*) dan tidak memakai SDK abstraction yang ada?

Di frontend, UI SDK biasanya hanya mengurus bisnis logika (seperti hook dan sinkronisasi riwayat pesan) tanpa mengunci desain UI. Jadi di frontend, memakai abstraction yang ada biasanya sudah lebih dari cukup kecuali ada kebutuhan autentikasi khusus atau gRPC.

Tapi di backend, kita bakal jauh lebih cepat nemu batasan kalau cuma mengandalkan tool loop bawaan. Di aplikasi produksi nyata, kita butuh kontrol lebih. Contohnya ChatGPT punya fitur auto-model: saat pesan masuk, mereka menjalankan *classifier LLM* dulu untuk mengukur tingkat kesulitan pertanyaan, baru mengarahkannya (*routing*) ke model yang pas. Logika seperti ini yang bikin kita harus turun ke low-level dan bikin sendiri.
Anda adalah penerjemah profesional Bahasa Inggris ke Bahasa Indonesia. Terjemahkan secara alami seperti seorang instruktur teknologi Indonesia sedang menjelaskan materi kepada sesama developer.

Terjemahkan:
So a note here, we are not using a database to store any of the canvas stuff. It gets stored in your browser. Excalidraw is stored in your browser, so if you refresh it, it's gone, OK? The reason I'm telling you that is because we are going to be creating a new session, a new chat session on every refresh. If we don't do that, you'll refresh and your canvas will be empty, but then your chat will still have messages in it, and then you're basically gaslighting AI at that point because it thinks it has all this stuff in the history, which it does, but the canvas in which it's referred to is gone. So you're just setting it up to fail. So we're going to be doing a new session on every refresh.

Catatan soal pengelolaan sesi: kita tidak memakai database untuk menyimpan data canvas (Excalidraw). Data canvas tersimpan di browser, jadi kalau di-refresh, datanya akan hilang.

Makanya kita membuat sesi chat baru setiap kali halaman di-refresh. Kalau sesi lama dipakai saat canvas sudah kosong, AI bakal bingung karena riwayat percakapannya merujuk ke data canvas yang sudah tidak ada. Membuat sesi baru setiap refresh memastikan status canvas dan riwayat chat selalu sinkron.
